hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, subprocess
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
file = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
if file.endswith('.py'):
    subprocess.run(['venv/bin/black', '--quiet', file])
    subprocess.run(['venv/bin/ruff', 'check', '--fix', '--quiet', file])
" 2>/dev/null || true
